title: Weeks Before Trump-Xi Jinping Meeting, US Admin Sanctions Major Chinese Refinery, 40 Tankers Over Iran Oil
description: The Trump administration sanctioned China’s Hengli Petrochemical refinery and 40 shipping firms for transporting Iranian oil, while blockading the Strait of Hormuz, weeks before Trump’s planned meeting with Xi Jinping.

title: US imposes sanctions on a China-based oil refinery and 40 shippers over Iranian oil
description: The Trump administration is sanctioning a major China-based oil refinery and about 40 shipping companies. The move announced Friday is part of a campaign to cut off Iran’s oil exports, a key revenue source. The U.S. has also imposed a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, crucial for energy exports. Hengli Petrochemical’s facility in Dalian is included in the sanctions. Since 2023, it has received Iranian crude oil shipments. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the agency will continue to restrict Iran’s oil network. The sanctions come amid turmoil in the global energy trade. China has said the use of sanctions “undermines international trade order and rules."

title: China’s Pressure Derails Taiwan President’s Africa Visit, Raises Global Concern
description: Three African countries suddenly denied flight permission for Taiwan President William Lai during his planned trip to Eswatini.

title: China's pressure tactics disrupt Taiwan President's Africa trip, spark global concern
description: The United States and Japan have raised strong objections after three African nations abruptly withdrew overflight permissions for Taiwanese President William Lai's planned trip to Eswatini, a move widely seen as influenced by China, as reported by The Taipei Times.

title: China bans dual-use items exports to 7 European entities over Taiwan arms sales
description: BEIJING, April 24 - China's Commerce Ministry said on Friday it was banning exports of dual-use items to seven European entities over arms sales to Taiwan, placing them immediately on its export control list, in a rare case of Europe-targeted, Taiwan-related sanctions. Read more at straitstimes.com.

title: China Sanctions European Firms Over Taiwan Arms Sales
description: China has imposed sanctions on seven European entities, banning exports of dual-use items due to their participation in arms sales to Taiwan. These measures are part of China's efforts to deter foreign arms sales to the island, which it considers its territory. Impact on businesses varies among affected firms.

title: China Restricts Dual-Use Exports to European Firms Amid Taiwan Arms Sales
description: China's Commerce Ministry has banned exports of dual-use items to seven European entities due to arms sales to Taiwan. The move includes notable firms and highlights China's strict stance on Taiwan-related military dealings. Europe has refrained from major arms sales to Taiwan for decades, fearful of China's reaction.
